correctness.rationale: A nonzero c-fold product forces each length-k subproduct into S^k minus S^{k+1}; singleton preterminal layer permits factor replacement to produce a forbidden nonzero c-th power. Distler also supplies an earlier implication of this lower bound. Hook and parity families have explicit associative laws, 2c elements, nonzero c-fold products, zero (c+1)-fold products and no nonzero c-th powers. The parity family has c even>=4 and is distinguished by square-zero indecomposable generators. The 16-model checker tested all 76,824 associativity triples, layers, and powers, without substituting finite tests for proof. The only imported deep result is Wang–Yin–Wang Corollary 1.2.

value.rationale: Minimal host size at fixed nilpotency index is a natural sharp invariant in the recent classification of full power-semiring finite basability; it controls the smallest semigroup and hence smallest cardinality of a counterexample full power semiring. The exact all-index bound is achieved explicitly, and the parity-dependent second nonisomorphic equality family reveals actual variety among extremizers. The result is not a new proof of the prior lower bound, nor an arbitrary finite parameter recomputation.
